solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: About a hundred damaged trees are hidden

indicators.note: the rearranged letters of the trees wrap themselves around the hundred
damaged trees are knocked out of shape, so their letters are reshuffled

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Something has happened to a hundred storm-damaged trees, which now lie out of sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' reorders TREES to SERET, and 'About' puts that around C.
explanation.definitionFit: Something kept secret is concealed from view or knowledge, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: First Lady points out sins count

indicators.note: the two points sit out on either side, enclosing the Lady between them

parts.note: S and N are compass points, south and north
Eve was the first woman in Genesis

explanation.surface: The original First Lady lists the sins she has committed and tallies them up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' places S and N outside EVE.
explanation.definitionFit: There are traditionally seven deadly sins, so their tally is this number.

clue.text: Spies seizing port with tip-off for treecreepers

indicators.note: the spies grab hold of the port, which ends up held within them

parts.note: the CIA is the US intelligence agency

indicators.note: the port loses its tip, its opening letter

parts.note: Perth is a port city in Western Australia (and Scotland's Perth lies on a river)

explanation.surface: Secret agents seize a harbour after a tip-off, all in the name of some birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tip-off' looks like an informer's warning but means 'with tip-off' removes the first letter; 'seizing' signals containment. Certhia is the zoological genus name, so the plural definition is fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Certhia is the scientific genus containing the small woodland birds called treecreepers.

clue.text: Why I get to change number

indicators.note: the letters of the preceding words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asks why they are allowed to alter a figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' rearranges WHYIGETTO.
explanation.definitionFit: Eighty-two is a particular integer, so it is an example of a number.

clue.text: Capital stimulus a kangaroo produces

indicators.note: the phrase brings out the answer from within its own letters

explanation.surface: A kangaroo gives some sort of financial boost to a city.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'stimuLUS A KAngaroo'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lusaka is the capital city of Zambia.

clue.text: Normal to find saunas odd in mid- July

indicators.note: the selected sauna letters are placed in the middle of the July letters
only the central letters of the month are taken
the odd-numbered letters, first, third and fifth, are used

explanation.surface: It is quite ordinary to find odd saunas in mid-summer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' means the odd-positioned letters, not strange saunas; 'mid-' takes the inner letters of the month and 'in' sets one inside the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Usual means ordinary or customary, a direct synonym of normal.

clue.text: Loan leading to progress

definitions.meaning: money lent, such as part of a salary paid early
to move forward or make progress

explanation.surface: Borrowing money as a route to getting on in life.
explanation.definitionFit: An advance is both a sum lent ahead of time and a forward movement.

clue.text: Exploit coming over the river

indicators.note: in a down answer the coming sits over, above, the river

parts.note: an advent is an arrival or coming
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, a crossword favourite

explanation.surface: Someone takes advantage by crossing over the river.
explanation.definitionFit: An exploit is a daring deed, which is what an adventure is.

clue.text: Mean to state the time

parts.note: to aver is to state or assert
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone intends to tell what time it is.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean of a set of numbers is its arithmetic average, a mathematical synonym.

clue.text: Last incomplete exam penned by firm

indicators.note: the shortened exam is enclosed, as if in a pen, by the firm

parts.note: sure means firm or steady, as in a sure footing

indicators.note: the exam word loses its final letter

parts.note: a viva is an oral examination, especially at university

explanation.surface: The final exam, left unfinished, was written up by a company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last' is the verb, to endure, not 'final'. 'incomplete' drops the exam's end letter and 'penned by' encloses it. A viva is an oral university exam.
explanation.definitionFit: To last is to keep going or endure, which is what surviving means.

clue.text: Bill creating trouble for short Malawi leader

indicators.note: the letters are troubled, stirred up into a new order
the country's name is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: a king is a leader of a nation

explanation.surface: A piece of legislation causes problems for a diminutive Malawian ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims the country's last letter and 'trouble for' rearranges what remains; the leader follows. 'Bill creating' is the definition, not 'Bill'.
explanation.definitionFit: Creating a bill, a draft act of parliament, is the business of making laws.

clue.text: Following triathlon, exhaustion's starting to be replaced

indicators.note: re-placed, the letters are put back in a fresh arrangement
only the opening letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: After a triathlon, tiredness begins to give way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starting' gives E from exhaustion's; 'to be replaced' rearranges TRIATHLON with E.
explanation.definitionFit: To be on the trail of something is to be tracking or pursuing it.

clue.text: Order members' pigeons

definitions.meaning: members of a religious order; read with the apostrophe as plural
the nun is a breed of fancy pigeon with a hood-like crest

explanation.surface: Birds belonging to people in a religious community.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuns belong to religious orders, and nun is also the name of a crested domestic pigeon breed.

clue.text: Eat a lot or nothing preserving energy

indicators.note: the fast keeps the energy safe inside it

parts.note: to fast is to eat nothing
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A choice between gorging and going without, while keeping one's strength up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nothing' stands for 'eat nothing', a fast, and 'preserving' holds E inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To feast is to dine lavishly and consume large amounts of food.

clue.text: Had fun finding "wet" in French dictionary

indicators.note: the wetting word goes inside the combination of the other two

parts.note: the OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
to lick something is to wet it with the tongue

explanation.surface: Someone enjoyed looking up a damp word in a French lexicon.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks around 'wet' flag it as a word to be read cryptically, here as a verb; 'in' puts it inside the French-plus-dictionary pair.
explanation.definitionFit: To frolic is to play about merrily, so frolicked means had fun.

clue.text: With canteen opening early, Protestants made a mistake

parts.note: a mess is a military canteen or dining hall

indicators.note: only the first letter of the following word is taken

parts.note: the DUP, Democratic Unionist Party, is a Northern Ireland party of largely Protestant unionists

explanation.surface: When the canteen opened ahead of time, some Protestants got things wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: The DUP is a mainly Protestant Northern Irish political party.
explanation.definitionFit: To have messed up is the informal idiom for having blundered.

clue.text: Bit of maths problematic for the oyster

indicators.note: the letters are made a problem of, thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A bit of maths causes difficulties for a shellfish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'problematic for' rearranges THEOYSTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Set theory is the branch of mathematics dealing with collections of objects.

clue.text: Congratulations for charitable actions

explanation.surface: Praise for doing good deeds.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both an exclamation of praise and a term for kindly deeds done for others.

clue.text: Little bit of excitement in rather boring fighter

indicators.note: the small bit of excitement is placed inside the boring word

parts.note: duller means more boring, the comparative giving 'rather'

indicators.note: just the first letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: A tedious fighter gets a small burst of thrill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little bit of' gives E; 'in' puts it inside DULLER.
explanation.definitionFit: A dueller is someone who fights duels, a combatant.

clue.text: Sign over letter after removing a terrible detail

indicators.note: the given letter is first taken away from the following word's letters
the remaining letters are terribly jumbled

explanation.surface: A mark placed on a letter after an awful detail has been cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after removing' takes A from DETAIL, leaving DETIL, and 'terrible' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A tilde is the wavy diacritic written above a letter, as in Spanish ñ.

clue.text: Beware of guard

definitions.meaning: a person keeping watch, a guard

explanation.surface: A warning about a sentry.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a shouted warning to be careful and a noun for a sentry on watch.

clue.text: Light flame of passion in sack

explanation.surface: A burning romantic passion kept in a bag.
explanation.definitionFit: Fire is to ignite, the ardour of strong emotion, and slang for dismissing an employee.

clue.text: Succeed by following beat

indicators.note: the 'by' word comes after the 'beat' word

parts.note: to beat an opponent is to win
through means by way of, as in 'by means of'

explanation.surface: Someone triumphs by keeping in step with the rhythm.
explanation.definitionFit: To win through is the idiom for finally triumphing after difficulty.

clue.text: Labour's compositions

definitions.meaning: a composer's ... are the pieces composed

explanation.surface: Pieces written by the Labour Party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour's' looks like the party's possessive, but it is labours, the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Works means toils away, and also creative pieces such as musical opuses.

clue.text: Brilliance of jungle ambush

indicators.note: the answer is made out of letters belonging to the words that follow

explanation.surface: A dazzling quality to an attack in the jungle.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'junGLE AMbush'.
explanation.definitionFit: A gleam is a flash or glint of light, shining brightness.

clue.text: Heavens! Trick produces bird

parts.note: the sky is the heavens
a lark is a prank or trick

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise as a conjuring trick makes a bird appear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heavens!' looks like an exclamation but means the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: The skylark is a songbird famous for singing in flight.

clue.text: Wolves' leaders to count on yellow outfits to excite supporters

definitions.note: read as plural wolves; the apostrophe belongs to the surface

indicators.note: the leading letters of each following word are taken

explanation.surface: Wolverhampton Wanderers' managers rely on gold kits to rouse the fans.
explanation.walkthrough: Wolves is the nickname of Wolverhampton Wanderers, an English football club playing in gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Coyotes are North American wild dogs, also called prairie wolves.

clue.text: Force to turn into don

indicators.note: the turn goes into the middle of the donning word

parts.note: to don clothes is to dress
U is a turn, as in a U-turn

explanation.surface: A command to change into a gown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'don' is the verb to put on, not a university fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Duress is compulsion by threats, being forced to act.

clue.text: Order NY team to return after story ends

indicators.note: the returning team comes after the story's ends
only the two end letters of the word are taken
the team name is turned back to front

parts.note: the Mets are a New York baseball team

explanation.surface: A New York side is told to come home once the tale is over.
explanation.definitionFit: A system is an orderly arrangement or method, so order is a synonym.
